end.summary: Practised defining physical change as no new substance, with changes in shape, size, or state.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes using trunk bending, melting ice, and melting ghee. They used reversibility and “no new substance” as helpful methods. The distinction between physical and chemical change became mixed up when discussing roasted chapati; it was not clearly corrected by the end (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, sort examples such as melting ice, rusting, and cooking chapati into physical or chemical changes and explain why.
